title: Beyond Exact Match: Task-Aware GRPO for Cross-Domain PCBA Visual Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2609.21276v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In automated Printed Circuit Board Assembly (PCBA) inspection, standards-guided decisions require systems to jointly reason over fine-grained visual cues, component semantics, and manufacturing knowledge. Although large vision-language models (VLMs) provide a promising foundation, their deployment is hindered by the domain shift between standards-derived samples and real-world production-line imagery, together with heterogeneous output spaces spanning choice-based and numerical counting tasks. To address these challenges, we propose a multimodal reasoning framework for cross-domain PCBA visual question answering. The framework converts standards-derived, real-world, and auxiliary PCB-domain data into a unified instruction format and constructs verified reasoning traces aligned with visual evidence, question semantics, candidate options, and ground-truth answers. translated_title: 超越精确匹配：面向跨领域PCBA视觉问答的任务感知GRPO
translated_abstract: 在自动化印刷电路板组装（PCBA）检测中，基于标准的决策需要系统对细粒度视觉线索、组件语义和制造知识进行联合推理。尽管大型视觉语言模型（VLM）为此提供了有前景的基础，但标准衍生样本与真实生产线图像之间的领域偏移，以及涵盖选择题和数值计数任务的异构输出空间，阻碍了这些模型的部署。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个用于跨领域PCBA视觉问答的多模态推理框架。该框架将标准衍生数据、真实世界数据和辅助PCB领域数据转换为统一的指令格式，并构建了与视觉证据、问题语义、候选选项和真实答案对齐的经过验证的推理轨迹。我们进一步引入了任务感知组相对策略优化（GRPO），
tldr: 提出了一种结合任务感知GRPO的多模态推理框架，通过统一指令格式与验证推理轨迹，解决了PCBA视觉问答中标准数据与真实产线图像间的领域偏移及异构输出空间难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a multimodal reasoning framework with Task-Aware GRPO that tackles domain shift between standards-derived samples and real production-line imagery, as well as heterogeneous output spaces, in cross-domain PCBA visual question answering.
